name: Alliance
summary: Across Azeroth, the Alliance now gathers its peoples around Stormwind. Its roots lie in Lordaeron's ruin, and its heart is Stormwind City, beside Ironforge's dwarves, the exiled gnomes, and Kalimdor's night elves.

sections.title: From Lordaeron to Stormwind
sections.body:
The modern Alliance descends from the Alliance of Lordaeron. During the Second War, Sir Anduin Lothar led Stormwind refugees north and united the Seven Kingdoms, dwarves, and high elves against the Old Horde.

The Scourge and the Third War ravaged the north. Lordaeron lay in ruins, and survivors were driven into scattered resistance. The restored Kingdom of Stormwind filled the void. Today it is the foremost seat of human leadership, carrying honor and faith into a fractured world.

sections.title: A Coalition of Necessity and Kinship
sections.body:
In the Eastern Kingdoms, the Alliance rests on the steadfast bond between humans and the dwarves of Ironforge, ruled by King Magni Bronzebeard. Gnomes also live among the dwarves, driven from Gnomeregan by a devastating trogg uprising.

High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque guides the exiled gnomes. They bring their brilliant engineering to the Alliance war effort, believing the coalition must survive if they are ever to reclaim their irradiated home.

sections.title: The Kalimdor Front
sections.body:
Across the Great Sea, the reclusive night elves left millennia of isolation after the Battle of Mount Hyjal. They lost their immortality and now clash bitterly with the Horde over logging in Ashenvale. So the kaldorei allied with their newfound mortal companions.

Cultural friction remains. Some traditionalists condemn the presence of humans and dwarves in ancient forests. The Alliance offers vital military and diplomatic help to guard Kalimdor from demonic remnants and Horde expansion.

sections.title: Uneasy Shadows
sections.body:
The Alliance faces strains within its own ranks. King Varian Wrynn vanished under mysterious circumstances while traveling to a diplomatic summit. His young son Anduin took the throne under Highlord Bolvar Fordragon's regency.

Relations with former human allies have also frayed. The maritime kingdom of Kul Tiras keeps its distance, while Sylvanas Windrunner's undead Forsaken hold the ruins of Lordaeron.

faq.q: What races make up the Alliance?
faq.answer: The Alliance's core peoples are the humans of Stormwind, the mountain dwarves of Ironforge, the exiled gnomes of Gnomeregan, and the night elves of Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who leads the Alliance right now?
faq.answer: No single absolute monarch rules the whole Alliance. Stormwind is ruled by the boy king anduin wrynn under highlord bolvar fordragon, his regent, after King Varian Wrynn disappeared. The other member nations follow King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge, High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque of the gnomes, and the night elf leadership on Kalimdor.

faq.q: How did the Alliance of Lordaeron become the modern Alliance?
faq.answer: King Terenas Menethil II and Anduin Lothar established the original Alliance to repel the Old Horde during the Second War. After the Scourge destroyed Lordaeron in the Third War, leadership shifted south to the rebuilt Kingdom of Stormwind, which forged new covenants with the dwarves, gnomes, and night elves.

faq.q: Why did the night elves join the Alliance?
faq.answer: After the Third War and the Battle of Mount Hyjal, the night elves lost their immortality and could no longer remain secluded. The Orcish Horde was actively deforesting Warsong Gulch in Ashenvale, so the kaldorei made a military pact with the humans and dwarves to defend their ancestral lands.

faq.q: Why is Kul Tiras not part of the Alliance right now?
faq.answer: Kul Tiras was a pillar of the old Alliance of Lordaeron, but it has kept to itself since that alliance splintered. Its Grand Admiral, Daelin Proudmoore, invaded Durotar and was slain by the Horde. The island kingdom has not joined the new Alliance led from Stormwind.

faq.q: Why didn't the gnomes help during the Third War?
faq.answer: During the Third War, a subterranean trogg invasion struck Gnomeregan. Believing the Scourge threat to the surface was greater, the gnomes concealed their crisis from their allies and fought alone. Radiation and invasion brought down the city, forcing survivors into Ironforge.

faq.q: What is the Alliance's stance toward the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Many in the Alliance regard the undead as abominations and tools of the Scourge that destroyed Lordaeron. The Alliance remains openly hostile toward the undead who are reclaiming the northern kingdom.

angles.text: As the chief architects of the faction's recovery, humans see the Alliance as civilization's rightful defender and a guardian of the Church of the Holy Light against wild and demonic forces.
The dwarves of Ironforge are humanity's most steadfast and loyal allies. They lend the Alliance their formidable iron, mountain infantry, and deep friendship.
As refugees in Ironforge, gnomes bring their scientific ingenuity to Alliance armadas. They trust that loyalty between allies will one day provide the strength to liberate Gnomeregan.
Driven from isolation by the Third War, night elves must find a necessary kinship with the younger races to check Horde aggression in Ashenvale.
Your sworn faction fights across two continents to preserve law, tradition, and mortal sovereignty against the Scourge, wild beasts, and the advancing Horde.
The Horde sees the Alliance as an entrenched, expansionist power whose self-righteous ideals threaten its members' sovereignty and survival on their lands.
